name: @aicad/desktop
description: The aicad desktop shell (Electron): sandboxed renderer serving @aicad/app over a COOP/COEP app:// protocol, a typed preload bridge, native menus wired to the command layer, and the Forge CLI engine over IPC.
author: aicad contributors

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm --filter "@aicad/desktop^..." run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm --filter "@aicad/desktop^..." run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.test:e2e:fallback: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm --filter "@aicad/desktop^..." run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/e2e-fallback.mjs
